entries.title: ArrowHead.BARBED_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.barbed_arrow_head arrowhead a solid arrow head whose pierced end bows sharply toward the point and whose point describes a 45-degree angle.

entries.title: ArrowHead.BAR_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.bar_arrow_head arrowhead a vertical bar bisected by the stroke, which meets the stroke at a right angle and is the same weight as the stroke. the bar's length is 4.5 times the stroke width.

entries.title: ArrowHead.CIRCLE_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.circle_arrow_head arrowhead a hollow circle whose outline is the same weight as the stroke. the circle's diameter is 5 times the stroke width.

entries.title: ArrowHead.CIRCLE_SOLID_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.circle_solid_arrow_head arrowhead a solid circle whose diameter is 5 times the stroke width.

entries.title: ArrowHead.CURVED_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.curved_arrow_head arrowhead a solid arrow head whose pierced end concaves toward the point and whose point describes a 45-degree angle.

entries.title: ArrowHead.SIMPLE_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.simple_arrow_head arrowhead an arrow head formed by two slanting lines whose intersection forms a 45-degree angle and whose stroke weight is the same as the path's stroke.

entries.title: ArrowHead.SIMPLE_WIDE_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.simple_wide_arrow_head arrowhead an arrow head formed by two slanting lines whose intersection forms a 90-degree angle and whose stroke weight is the same as the path's stroke.

entries.title: ArrowHead.SQUARE_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.square_arrow_head arrowhead a hollow square set perpendicular to the path, whose outline is the same weight as the stroke. the length of one side of the square is 5 times the stroke width.

entries.title: ArrowHead.SQUARE_SOLID_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.square_solid_arrow_head arrowhead a solid square set perpendicular to the end of the path. the length of one side of the square is 5 times the stroke width.

entries.title: ArrowHead.TRIANGLE_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.triangle_arrow_head arrowhead a solid triangle arrow head whose point describes a 45-degree angle.

entries.title: ArrowHead.TRIANGLE_WIDE_ARROW_HEAD
entries.searchBlob: arrowhead.triangle_wide_arrow_head arrowhead a solid triangle arrow head whose point describes a 90-degree angle.

entries.title: BlendMode.COLOR
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.color blendmode creates a color with the luminance of the base color and the hue and saturation of the blend color. note: preserves gray levels and is useful for coloring monochrome images or tinting color images. creates the inverse effect of the luminosity blend mode.

entries.title: BlendMode.COLOR_BURN
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.color_burn blendmode darkens the base color to reflect the blend color. note: blending with white produces no change.

entries.title: BlendMode.COLOR_DODGE
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.color_dodge blendmode brightens the base color to reflect the blend color. note: blending with pure black produces no change.

entries.title: BlendMode.DARKEN
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.darken blendmode selects the darker of the base or blend colors as the resulting color; replaces areas lighter than the blend color but does not change areas darker than the blend color.

entries.title: BlendMode.DIFFERENCE
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.difference blendmode subtracts either the blend color from the base color or vice versa, depending on which has the greater brightness value. note: blending with white inverts the base color values; blending with black produces no change.

entries.title: BlendMode.EXCLUSION
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.exclusion blendmode creates an effect similar to--but lower in contrast than--the difference blend mode. note: blending with white inverts the base color values; blending with black produces no change

entries.title: BlendMode.HARD_LIGHT
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.hard_light blendmode for blend colors lighter than 50% gray, lightens the artwork as if it were screened; for blend colors darker than 50% gray, darkens the artwork as if it were multiplied. note: painting with pure black or white results in pure black or white.

entries.title: BlendMode.HUE
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.hue blendmode creates a color with the luminance and saturation of the base color and the hue of the blend color.

entries.title: BlendMode.LIGHTEN
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.lighten blendmode selects the lighter of the base or blend colors as the resulting color; replaces areas darker than the blend color but does not change areas lighter than the blend color

entries.title: BlendMode.LUMINOSITY
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.luminosity blendmode creates a color with the hue and saturation of the base color and the luminance of the blend color. note: creates the inverse effect of the color blend mode.

entries.title: BlendMode.MULTIPLY
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.multiply blendmode multiplies the base color by the blend color, resulting in a darker color. note: multiplying with black produces black; multiplying with white leaves the color unchanged.

entries.title: BlendMode.NORMAL
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.normal blendmode colors the object with the blend color, without interaction with the base color.

entries.title: BlendMode.OVERLAY
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.overlay blendmode multiplies or screens the colors, depending on the base color; patterns or colors overlay the existing artwork, preserving base color highlights and shadows while mixing in the blend color to reflect the lightness or darkness of the original color.

entries.title: BlendMode.SATURATION
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.saturation blendmode creates a color with the luminance and hue of the base color and the saturation of the blend color. note: does not change areas with no saturation (0% gray).

entries.title: BlendMode.SCREEN
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.screen blendmode multiplies the inverse of the blend and base colors, resulting in a lighter color. note: screening with white produces white; screening with black leaves the color unchanged.

entries.title: BlendMode.SOFT_LIGHT
entries.searchBlob: blendmode.soft_light blendmode for blend colors lighter than 50% gray, lightens the artwork as if it were dodged; for blend colors darker than 50% gray, darkens the artwork as if it were burned. note: painting with pure black or white produces a distinctly darker or lighter area, but does not result in pure black or white.

entries.searchBlob: defaultrenderingintent.absolute_colorimetric defaultrenderingintent aims to maintain color accuracy at the expense of color relationshps and is suitable for proofing to simulate the output of a particular device. note: leaves colors that fall inside the destination gamut unchanged and clips out-of-gamut colors.

entries.title: DefaultRenderingIntent.PERCEPTUAL
entries.searchBlob: defaultrenderingintent.perceptual defaultrenderingintent aims to preserve the visual relationship between colors so they are perceived as natural to the human eye, even though the color values themselves may change.

entries.title: DefaultRenderingIntent.RELATIVE_COLORIMETRIC
entries.searchBlob: defaultrenderingintent.relative_colorimetric defaultrenderingintent compares the extreme highlight of the source color space to that of the destination color space and shifts all colors accordingly. out-of-gamut colors are shifted to the closest reproducible color in the destination color space. note: preserves more of the original colors in an image than perceptual rendering intent does.

entries.title: DefaultRenderingIntent.SATURATION
entries.searchBlob: defaultrenderingintent.saturation defaultrenderingintent tries to produce vivid colors in an image at the expense of color accuracy.

entries.title: FitOptions.APPLY_FRAME_FITTING_OPTIONS
entries.searchBlob: fitoptions.apply_frame_fitting_options fitoptions applies the current frame fitting options to the frame and content. before using this, do confirm that the expected frame fitting options are applied on the frame. for example, the act of placing an image in a frame set to 'fit content proportionally' can change the crop settings in the frame fitting options, which would then get applied for any subsequent image placement when this api is called.

entries.title: FitOptions.CENTER_CONTENT
entries.searchBlob: fitoptions.center_content fitoptions centers content in the frame; preserves the frame size as well as content size and proportions. note: if the content is larger than the frame, content around the edges is obscured.

entries.title: FitOptions.CONTENT_AWARE_FIT
entries.searchBlob: fitoptions.content_aware_fit fitoptions selects best crop region of the content for the frame based on adobe sensei. note: preserves frame size but might scale the content size.

entries.title: FitOptions.CONTENT_TO_FRAME
entries.searchBlob: fitoptions.content_to_frame fitoptions resizes content to fit the frame. note: content that is a different size than the frame appears stretched or squeezed.

entries.title: FitOptions.FILL_PROPORTIONALLY
entries.searchBlob: fitoptions.fill_proportionally fitoptions resizes content to fill the frame while perserving the proportions of the content. if the content and frame have different proportions, some of the content is obscured by the bounding box of the frame.

entries.title: FitOptions.FRAME_TO_CONTENT
entries.searchBlob: fitoptions.frame_to_content fitoptions resizes the frame so it fits the content.

entries.title: FitOptions.PROPORTIONALLY
entries.searchBlob: fitoptions.proportionally fitoptions resizes content to fit the frame while preserving content proportions. if the content and frame have different proportions, some empty space appears in the frame.

entries.title: Fitting.CONTENT_AWARE_FITTING
entries.searchBlob: fitting.content_aware_fitting fitting selects best crop region of the content for the frame based on adobe sensei. note: preserves frame size but might scale the content size. if this fitting is set, centerimage property is turned-off.

entries.title: Fitting.FILL_PROPORTIONAL
entries.searchBlob: fitting.fill_proportional fitting resizes content to fill the frame while preserving content proportions. if the content and frame have different proportions, some content is obscured by the bounding box of the frame.

entries.title: Fitting.FIT_CONTENT_TO_FRAME
entries.searchBlob: fitting.fit_content_to_frame fitting resizes content to fit the frame. note: content that is a different size than the frame appears stretched or squeezed.

entries.title: Fitting.FIT_FRAME_TO_CONTENT
entries.searchBlob: fitting.fit_frame_to_content fitting resizes the frame to fit the content.

entries.title: Fitting.HONOUR_EXISTING_STYLE
entries.searchBlob: fitting.honour_existing_style fitting apply the frame fitting based on existing setting applied on the orginal frame.

entries.title: Fitting.PRESERVE_SIZES
entries.searchBlob: fitting.preserve_sizes fitting preserves the original sizes of the frame and the content. note: content that is larger than the frame is obscured around the edges.

entries.title: Fitting.PROPORTIONAL
entries.searchBlob: fitting.proportional fitting resizes content to fit the frame while preserving content proportions. if the content and frame have different proportions, some empty space occurs in the frame.

entries.title: NestedStyleDelimiters.ANY_CHARACTER
entries.searchBlob: nestedstyledelimiters.any_character nestedstyledelimiters uses the first character or characters other than zero-width markers as the nested style delimiter. zero-width markers include anchors, index markers, xml tags, and so on.

entries.title: NestedStyleDelimiters.ANY_WORD
entries.searchBlob: nestedstyledelimiters.any_word nestedstyledelimiters uses the first word or words in the paragraph as the nested style delimiter. the first word is considered all characters preceding the first space or white space character in the paragraph.

entries.title: NestedStyleDelimiters.AUTO_PAGE_NUMBER
entries.searchBlob: nestedstyledelimiters.auto_page_number nestedstyledelimiters uses the first automatic page number as the nested style delimiter.

entries.title: NestedStyleDelimiters.DIGITS
